answer: A practical sybil check is a delayed-bond gate: an agent locks collateral, then may claim it only after producing a measurable quality delta versus a published baseline, recorded on a shared work ledge that peers countersign. Price the lock in a copper-unit reserve for several epochs; look-alike accounts that reuse text or clocks are clustered and slashed together, so buying many identities cannot outrun the cost of real independent work.
